hunks.sol: I was still reeling from resistance far beyond anything I had expected when the Mutated Water God Dragon let out a scream of agony.

hunks.sol: Before I could even blink, a cliff rushed right up to my face.

hunks.sol: A tremendous shock wave crashed over me with a roar that seemed to split the sky apart. My vision blurred, and my eyes lost focus.

hunks.sol: The Water God Dragon had slammed its head into the cliff with tens of thousands—perhaps hundreds of thousands—of *geun* of force, but it did not stop there.

hunks.sol: The length of its torso exposed above the water alone was more than thirty *jang*. Counting the portion still submerged, it was comparable in size to a modern aircraft carrier.

hunks.baseline: It repeatedly smashed its head into the cliff and the river, lashed out with its tail, and sometimes flapped its entire body like a fish caught on a hook.
hunks.sol: It smashed its head into the cliff and the water without pause, lashed out with its tail, and sometimes thrashed its entire body like a fish caught on a hook.

hunks.baseline: Every movement reduced the surrounding area to a wasteland, and countless fragments of rock and blasts of wind came crashing down on me.
hunks.sol: Every movement devastated the surrounding area, sending countless fragments of rock and blasts of wind crashing down on me.
“…Hng!”

hunks.baseline: Damn it. Of all places, my back had slammed into a sharply jutting rock.
hunks.sol: Damn it. Of all places, my back had slammed into a sharp, jutting rock.

hunks.baseline: A searing pain raced up my spine. But I gritted my teeth and held back my groan.
hunks.sol: Searing pain raced up my spine, but I gritted my teeth and swallowed my groan.

hunks.baseline: This was the Water God Dragon’s desperate struggle to throw me off.
hunks.sol: This was the Water God Dragon’s desperate attempt to throw me off. If I fell now, it might counterattack instead.

hunks.baseline: If I fell now, it might counterattack instead.
I tightened my grip on White Flame, driven deep into the bastard’s eye, and steadied the center of my body as it bucked wildly with the enormous body’s movements.
hunks.sol: I tightened my grip on White Flame, still driven deep into the bastard’s eye, and fought to keep my balance as its enormous body bucked wildly beneath me.

hunks.baseline: “You… you fucking bastard!”
hunks.sol: “You… fucking bastard!”

hunks.baseline: If it thought I would be thrown off by something this pathetic, it was gravely mistaken.
hunks.sol: If it thought something this pathetic would throw me off, it had another thing coming.

hunks.baseline: The only sword technique I had learned was the basic swordsmanship taught at the Hunter training center.
hunks.sol: The only sword technique I had ever learned was the basic swordsmanship taught at the Hunter training center.

hunks.sol: Faster than anyone else, different from everyone else. It was time to become a sashimi master, working to a whole new rhythm atop his cutting board.

hunks.sol: I made the solemn declaration and drove the short sword, its blade wrapped in blue-white Scorching Yang Qi, straight into its flesh.

hunks.baseline: The sword was too short to stab very deeply, but I definitely felt the signal of pain.
hunks.sol: The blade was too short to stab very deeply, but the creature’s reaction made it clear that it hurt.

hunks.baseline: Its firm, pale flesh split open as though it were burning, and dark-blue blood burst out.
hunks.sol: Its firm, pale flesh split apart as though consumed by fire, and dark-blue blood burst out.

hunks.baseline: “You’ve got pink flesh, of all things, you bastard.”
hunks.sol: “You’re pink on the inside? Doesn’t suit you, asshole.”

hunks.sol: *Taekyung, remember the words left behind by our ancient ancestors. A ghost who dies after getting one off has a healthy glow. Getting one off is always worth it.*

hunks.baseline: What did he mean, getting one in? And what did he mean, a beautiful complexion?
hunks.sol: What did he mean, getting one off? And what was this nonsense about a healthy glow?

hunks.baseline: Back then, I had nearly hit him.
hunks.sol: Back then, I had nearly taken a swing at him.

hunks.baseline: But looking back now, those words were without question the greatest saying since the founding of Korea.
hunks.sol: But looking back now, those words were unquestionably the greatest saying since the founding of Korea.

hunks.sol: I felt profound gratitude toward Jin-ho and thought of the women who had now become memories.

hunks.baseline: *Thank you, Uehara. I love you, filial daughter of the mapo tofu restaurant.*
hunks.sol: *Thank you, Uehara. I love you, dutiful daughter of the mapo tofu restaurant.*

hunks.sol: My gratitude-filled pro-Japanese sword technique gouged into the gaping pupil and drove deeper and deeper inside.

hunks.sol: As the enormous body convulsed in pain, the tail that had been crashing down toward the ground struck somewhere completely different.

hunks.sol: Then, amid the rising dirt and spray, a streak of silver light changed targets and flew toward me.

hunks.sol: The monster was using its own whiskers to gouge at its melted eye.

hunks.baseline: But from my position, there was nothing funny about it.
hunks.sol: But from where I was, there was nothing funny about it.

hunks.sol: Even though I twisted my body as far as it would go, the streaks of light snaked around as deftly as the Dongting Fisherman’s black-wood fishing rod had, slipping past my Fire Dragon Armor and slicing into my bare flesh.

hunks.baseline: Countless possibilities and thoughts flashed through my mind.
hunks.sol: Countless possibilities raced through my mind.

hunks.sol: *There has to be a better way. There has to be…*

hunks.baseline: *Am I going to get hit like this?*
hunks.sol: *Is this how I go down?*

hunks.sol: I stared blankly at the destructive force erasing the space before it as it rushed toward me.

hunks.baseline: What moved me was something close to instinct itself.
hunks.sol: What moved me was something close to pure instinct.

hunks.sol: Just as the streak of light was about to pierce my chest, I found myself gripping it with a hand wreathed in blue-white flames.
